title: Cone Pivot and Face
description: Players dribble to a cone, pick up the ball, pivot to face an open target, and pass — tying together stopping, pivoting and seeing the floor.

content.objective: Stop cleanly at the cone, pivot to locate an open target, then deliver an accurate pass.
content.setup: A cone marks a stopping point; a target player waits at a wing.
instructions: Dribble toward the cone and pick up the ball with a jump-stop right at it.
Pivot to face the target player before passing.
Deliver an accurate pass once fully squared up.
The target returns the pass and the ball handler resets to repeat.
coachingPoints: Stop fully before picking up the dribble, not mid-stride.
Keep the pivot foot planted throughout the turn.
Square up fully before releasing the pass.
commonMistakes: Picking up the dribble while still moving, risking a travel.
Passing before the pivot is actually complete.
Rushing the stop before the feet are actually set.
content.safety: Keep the cone area clear of other groups' paths.
